426:t_100:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're persistent, $n. I'm $$アムブリエル$$.」

426:t_100:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Or is it that you just don't want to admit it? That your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ was a brazen woman like this all along?」

426:t_100:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're adorable, kid! If you weren't her student, you could have been a lot more honest!」

426:t_100:5.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... I don't know what kind of state you're in right now...」

426:t_100:6.en:
$n
「But I'm definitely getting you back! Miss $$スズネ$$ is my partner!」

426:t_100:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You cling to a puny hope so despair won't beat you, huh! That's exactly like you, $n!」

426:t_100:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Now then, you and I will fight over the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

426:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hang on, Miss $$スズネ$$! I'll save you right now!」

426:t_101:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「As expected of you, $$アルト$$. You've got a natural gift for handling women.」

426:t_101:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Ha ha ha, did that make you mad! Your prized wings are wobbling with rage!」

426:t_101:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If it stings, hurry up and settle your own affairs before you try anything with me!」

426:t_101:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...! Are these words... really Miss $$スズネ$$'s!?」

426:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll stop Miss $$スズネ$$ with the power of $$マジンガーＺ$$!」

426:t_102:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's pointless, $$甲児$$. I know all your habits inside out.」

426:t_102:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That way of fighting, leaning on $$マジンガーＺ$$, too. You can't stop me like that.」

426:t_102:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That unexpected sensitivity of yours is your weakness.」

426:t_102:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If you want to stop me, come at me ready to turn your beloved $$マジンガーＺ$$ into a devil!」

426:t_102:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn... damn it! What did $$バルビエル$$ do to Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_103:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「You'll have to put up with this for a moment, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_103:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Look who's talking, one of the top two problem students in the class. Who'd listen to anything you say?」

426:t_103:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Unbelievable... Is this really the Miss $$スズネ$$ I know?」

426:t_103:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Every woman is like this. She carries another self inside her heart.」

426:t_103:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Your beloved $$千鳥かなめ$$ is the same. Learn that.」

426:t_103:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I won't allow any more insults to $$千鳥$$...! Even from Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_104:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't let you get $n, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_104:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Still as fierce as ever, $$カレン$$. But with that attitude, no one will ever marry you.」

426:t_104:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Mind your own business! I don't plan on being taken by anybody! I grab what I want myself!」

426:t_104:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「We think alike. I'm the same.」

426:t_104:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So get out of the way! If you interfere with my taking the $$スフィア$$, I'll crush you!」

426:t_105:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Please stop it, Miss $$スズネ$$! I don't wanna fight you!」

426:t_105:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Sorry, $$ワッ太$$. Your teacher has her reasons, too...」

426:t_105:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're dead wrong if you thought I'd say that. You may not want to fight, but I sure do.」

426:t_105:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I show no mercy to anyone in my way, kids included! That's how I've lived!」

426:t_105:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Dammit! Miss $$スズネ$$, you big dummy! I can... do it when it counts, you know!!」

426:t_106:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$! Stop Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_106:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Play with your toys at home, $$正太郎$$. You're an eyesore.」

426:t_106:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「No way...! For Miss $$スズネ$$ to talk about $$鉄人$$ like that...」

426:t_106:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Admit it already. I'm $$アムブリエル$$.」

426:t_106:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm not the soft Miss $$スズネ$$ you all love so much, but $$アムブリエル$$ of the $$サイデリアル$$!」

426:t_107:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「B-but... it's Miss $$スズネ$$...! She's our teacher!」

426:t_107:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Still soft as ever, $$シンジ$$. I can hardly believe you rode an EVA that tried to destroy the world.」

426:t_107:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If you don't want to fight, all the better. That thing's A.T. Field is a pain.」

426:t_107:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If all you're going to do is cry and cling, get out of the way. I don't have time to deal with brats, either!」

426:t_108:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$...! Why has it come to this!?」

426:t_108:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Everyone has another self inside their heart. You of all people should understand, $$アマタ$$?」

426:t_108:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you talking about $$カグラ$$!?」

426:t_108:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's right. Not that it gives you any way to stop me.」

426:t_108:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Especially not you, fighting on faith in something like love!」

426:t_108:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ gave her blessing to $$ミコノ$$ and me...!」

426:t_108:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「What the hell are you!? Get out of Miss $$スズネ$$!!」

426:t_109:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I've been longing to see you, $$竜馬$$!」

426:t_109:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I always wanted to fight you just once! That dream is finally coming true!」

426:t_109:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Cut the jokes. Miss $$スズネ$$ is a fine colleague of mine. She's nothing like a violent woman like you!」

426:t_109:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I told you, didn't I? I'm not $$スズネ$$, I'm $$アムブリエル$$.」

426:t_109:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then I'll drive you out! To take our Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

426:t_110:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Nicely done, $$揺れる天秤$$. I never imagined $n would be saved by the aftershock of it, though.」

426:t_110:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not another word out of you.」

426:t_110:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even a woman-hater like me had some hopes for Miss $$スズネ$$, and you wrecked every one of them!」

426:t_110:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Sorry to disappoint! But this is who I am!」

426:t_110:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then I'll shut you up by force if I have to! For my own sanity... and for $n!」

426:t_111:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「A $$傷だらけの獅子$$ and a $$悲しみの乙女$$, huh... If I take you two down, I can already picture the frustrated faces of $$ストラウス$$ and $$バルビエル$$.」

426:t_111:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「No way... Miss $$スズネ$$ could change this much...」

426:t_111:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Please pull yourself together, Miss $$スズネ$$! None of us wants to fight you!」

426:t_111:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then stay out of it. My top-priority target is $n, after all.」

426:t_111:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's no use, $$セツコ$$! Words won't get through to her!」
